question_text: Write a summary of the above passage in your own words.
guide_solution: George Washington was born in Virginia in 1732. He managed his family's estates at age 20. In 1952, he joined the English forces during the war with France. In 1773, the Boston Tea Party occurred, leading to conflict between Britain and the American colonies. The colonies declared independence in 1776, and peace was made between America and Britain in 1783. Then, Washington returned his home of Virginia to live happily. In 1789, Washington become the first president of the United States.
